prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 22 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1160; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

Patient presented following a side-impact motor vehicle collision at an intersection with immediate pain and swelling of the left wrist. Radiographs demonstrated a closed distal radius fracture with mild dorsal angulation. Closed reduction was performed under local anesthesia, and the wrist was immobilized in a short arm cast. Follow-up radiographs confirmed maintenance of alignment. The patient attended a total of 22 visits over the course of treatment, including orthopedic follow-up, cast management, serial imaging, and a supervised hand therapy program addressing range of motion, grip strength, and functional use. Pain was managed with a combination of oral analgesics and ice, with gradual reduction in symptoms over time. At the most recent evaluation, the patient demonstrated near-full range of motion with residual mild stiffness in wrist extension and grip strength approximately 85 percent of the contralateral side. Continued home exercise and periodic reassessment are recommended. Prognosis for full functional recovery is good.
